name: WayriCAD Planar Magnetics & Actuator Workbench
description: Design PCB coils, transformers, inductors, motors, actuators, and magnetic torquers.
description_full: Generate multilayer and via-connected planar windings, estimate LCR, loss, field and force, then simulate coupled current, position, speed, acceleration, resonance, damping, travel stops, and thermal-noise limits for linear and rotary actuator concepts.
